1981-2415-7272-8319.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7272-8319.description:

When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life

728-1453-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-1453-4694-7306.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.

Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha

When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.

586-864-2279-3125-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-6495.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.
586-864-2279-3125-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3259-4068-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat as desired / able.

1618-2440-4258-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch
1618-2440-4258-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4258-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

997-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
997-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
997-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

1682-2366-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:

1682-2366-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.

974-3398-5446.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Esika's Chariot or Hellkite Charger.
974-3398-5446.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Esika's Chariot's crew ability by tapping the Smaug token, causing Esika's Chariot to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Esika's Chariot and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
974-3398-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may copy any other token(s) you control instead. You may also attack with a Warrior to get infinite creature tokens with haste.

643-4231-4508-5880.description:

Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Eternal Witness
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6174.easyPrerequisites:

When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Soul Stair Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Soul Stair Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.

Resolve the ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.

Resolve both Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 3.

880-2757-4677.description:

When the land enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.

Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.

Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is tapped and attacking.
Mnemonic Wall enters, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

907-1479-4862.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-4862.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

224-2499-5196.notablePrerequisites:
At least one basic land in hand.

Let the first Retreat trigger resolve, untapping Rootgrazer.
Tap Rootgrazer, returning any basic you control to your hand.
Let the second Retreat trigger resolve, untapping Rootgrazer.

600-1180-3062.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two copies of Nicol Bolas that enter with five loyalty counters each.
Repeat using a Nicol Bolas token instead.

643-4302-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

654-774-1846-4270.notablePrerequisites: At least 2 islands on the battlefield.
654-774-1846-4270.description:
Cast High Tide.
Tap two Islands for {4}.
Activate Trade Routes twice for {2}, returning the tapped Islands to hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon for {1}, putting both Islands onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping both Islands.
Repeat the loop, floating {U} each iteration.
